# alexander.xin

> Personal site of Alexander James Carter — writing, projects, tools, and public time API.

## Quick links

- [Home](https://alexander.xin/)
- [Site help](https://alexander.xin/help) — visitor Q&A from public fleet docs (`POST /api/help`)
- [Help knowledge base](https://alexander.xin/help/kb.json)
- [Auth for agents](https://alexander.xin/auth.md)
- [API catalog](https://alexander.xin/.well-known/api-catalog)
- [MCP server card](https://alexander.xin/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json)
- [Agent skills index](https://alexander.xin/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json)
- [Security contact](https://alexander.xin/.well-known/security.txt)
- [Sitemap](https://alexander.xin/sitemap-index.xml)
- [Network directory](https://alexander.xin/network.json)
- [Fleet changelog](https://alexander.xin/fleet-changelog.json)

## Public API

- Time: `GET https://api.alexander.xin/time/now`
- OpenAPI: https://alexander.xin/api/openapi-time.json

## Languages

Default locale is zh-CN at `/`. Other locales: `/zh-TW/`, `/en/`, `/fr/`, `/ru/`.

## Notes for agents

- Site content and the Time API are public; no OAuth bearer token is required.
- Prefer Markdown negotiation (`Accept: text/markdown`) when available.
- Human verification (`/verify`) gates some personal pages for browsers only.
